summary: Reproduced that make_shm_name('nodecheck') exceeds macOS's 30-character caller-visible POSIX shared-memory budget and that an OSError on the source rank makes in_the_same_node_as enter mismatched collectives. Shared-memory names are now capped while preserving the cleanup parser format, and every rank reaches the name broadcast even when creation fails.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: nodecheck was 32 characters for PID 12345 and a long future kind was 54 characters, both above the macOS limit. Raw output: reports/j-63a83dd4cc37/raw/failing_before_name.log

Failing-before two-rank Gloo reproduction: injecting OSError(63, 'File name too long') on the source rank caused collective timeouts/peer closure. The test was initially run at the equivalent temporary path test/registered/distributed/test_same_node_shm_failure.py before being moved into the registered unit layout. Raw output: reports/j-63a83dd4cc37/raw/failing_before_collective.log
Passing-after name-limit, uniqueness, PID parsing, cleanup, and production ShmRingBuffer coverage: 9 passed, 1 skipped. Raw output: reports/j-63a83dd4cc37/raw/passing_after_stale_shm.log

Passing-after two-rank Gloo coverage: source creation failure returns false on both ranks without deadlock, and the independent successful shared-memory probe returns true on both ranks; 2 passed. Raw output: reports/j-63a83dd4cc37/raw/passing_after_collective_final.log
Repository formatting, lint, registered-test validation, and static hooks all passed. Raw output: reports/j-63a83dd4cc37/raw/pre_commit_final.log

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and regression concern POSIX shared-memory naming and CPU Gloo collective control flow. Running an unrelated gfx950 smoke would not validate the reported macOS behavior.

remaining_limitations: No macOS host was available, so the platform's shm_open limit was validated from the reported boundary and deterministic length checks rather than an actual macOS kernel call.

The MLX Qwen --tp 2 launch was not run because this environment is Linux/ROCm and the requested model weights were not available; the regression covers the actual in_the_same_node_as implementation with a two-rank process group and the exact reported OSError.
This change prevents the silent deadlock and keeps generated names portable; it does not claim to make MLX tensor parallelism functional beyond this startup probe.
